Routines for Components

Targeting a Component Instance

Your component can target a component instance without capturing the component
or your component can first capture the component and then target a specific instance of the component. For information on capturing components, see "Capturing Components" beginning on page 6-72. To target a component instance, use the ComponentSetTarget function.
